metadata.title: Sóng — ride the same wave
metadata.description: Listen to independent music from Audius, alone or with friends.

discover.headline: Independent music, heard in full
discover.lede: The most-played tracks on Audius of all time, from bedroom producers to Skrillex and Zedd. Full tracks, free, artists credited.
discover.emptyBody: Audius didn't respond. Check your connection, then reload the page.
discover.attribution: Music provided by Audius. All rights belong to the artists.
discover.filtersHint: Pick a time window and a mood; moods filter by their closest genre.
discover.chartNote: What's most played on Deezer right now. Deezer only allows 30-second previews; select a title to hear the full track on Deezer.
discover.chartAttribution: Data and previews from Deezer. All rights belong to the artists and labels.

player.queueWithCount: Queue, {count, plural, =0 {nothing up next} one {# up next} other {# up next}}
player.reorderHint: Drag the handle to reorder, or press Alt + ↑/↓ on a focused track.

track.gated: The artist restricts streaming of this track on Audius, so Sóng can't play it.

artist.noTracks: This artist hasn't released any tracks yet.

search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter query, or check the spelling.

history.title: Listening history
history.localNote: History is kept in this browser. Once you sign in, it syncs to your account.
history.emptyBody: Any track you listen to for more than 30 seconds shows up here.

notFound.title: This page isn't here
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the track or artist was removed from Audius.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Sóng needs a connection to stream music. Pages you've opened before still work.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: Sóng couldn't load this page, usually because Audius is slow or the connection dropped. Your music keeps playing.
